title: Taskbase 2018 — taskbase.com relaunch
build: docker node:8 + @angular/cli 1.7.1: npm install then "ng build --prod --extract-css=false --base-href ./" (the repo's own build:prod flags). No workarounds needed — node-sass 4.x has a prebuilt binary for node 8.
notes: Real AOT production build of the original Angular 5 source, not a reconstruction. The redesign that became taskbase.com around 2018-04-20: Bootstrap 4 replaced Material, new jumbo, tech modules, customers, testimonials, offer, project, team, blog, contact form. Cross-checked against the Internet Archive snapshot of 2018-06-12 — same sections in the same order, and this build still has the images the archive lost. Contact form posts nowhere; Google Tag Manager stripped. Team page loads Google Maps live. Deep links (team, impressum, technology/0..5) work. The old specimen card is kept as specimen.html.
